resources.string: Access
Photos and videos
The keyboard can show all of your photos and videos.
The keyboard can show only the photos you chose. Allow again to choose more.
Not allowed. The tool opens the system picker instead.
Allow
Change
Browsing
Tap on a photo
The round check in the corner always picks.

What a tap on a photo in the gallery does. Open it full size shows the photo large, where you can edit it or send it. Pick it adds the photo to the ones you are about to send. The round check in the corner of a photo always picks it, whatever this setting says. The default is Open it full size.
Open it full size
Pick it
Columns
Pinch the grid to change this too.
How many photos the gallery shows in each row. More columns show more photos at once, each one smaller. A pinch on the grid changes the same setting. The default is 4.
Camera tile
A first square in the grid that opens the camera tool.
Adds a square at the start of the gallery grid that opens the camera tool, so you can take a new photo and send it. This setting is on by default.
Show videos
List videos beside the photos.
Lists your videos in the gallery together with the photos. Turn this off for a gallery of photos only. This setting is on by default.
Fast scroll by month
A handle on the right edge that jumps through the months.
Shows a handle on the right edge of the gallery. A drag on it jumps through your photos month by month, which is much faster than a scroll in a large library. This setting is on by default.
Open at full height
Off, the gallery opens at the keyboard\'s height and you drag it taller.
The gallery opens at the full height of the screen. With this off, it opens at the height of the keyboard, and you drag it taller when you need more room. This setting is off by default.
Open the last album
Off, the gallery always opens on Recents.
The gallery opens on the album you looked at last. With this off, it always opens on Recents. This setting is on by default.
Folders
Untick a folder to leave its photos out of the gallery, Recents included
All shown
Search folders
No folders with photos the keyboard can see. Allow photo access first.
Vibrate on each pick
A short tick under the finger when you pick or drop a photo.
The phone gives a short tick each time you pick a photo or remove one from your pick.
Sending
Picture size
The chip in the send bar changes it for one send. Videos go at their own size.

The size at which a photo is sent. A smaller picture sends faster and uses less data. The original keeps every detail. The chip in the send bar changes the size for one send only. Videos are always sent at their own size. The default is HD.
Original
HD, 2560 px
Standard, 1280 px
Small, 800 px
Pick up to
How many photos and videos go in one send.
The most photos and videos you can pick for one send. The default is 20.
Caption
Where the text you type in the send bar goes.
Where the text you type in the gallery\'s send bar goes: into the chat before the pictures, or after them. No caption box takes the text box out of the send bar. The default is After the pictures.
After the pictures
Before the pictures
No caption box
When the app does not take pictures
Some text boxes do not accept pictures or videos from a keyboard.

Some text boxes do not accept pictures or videos from a keyboard. This sets what the gallery does there. Share them to that app opens the app\'s own share screen with your pick. Copy them to the clipboard lets you paste them yourself. Ask each time shows both choices. The default is Share them to that app.
Share them to that app
Copy them to the clipboard
Ask each time
Close after sending
Give the keys back once everything is on its way.
After you send your pick, the gallery closes and the keys come back, so you can type at once. With this off, the gallery stays open for the next send. This setting is on by default.
Keep edited photos
Save a copy of each photo you edit to your gallery.
When you edit a photo before you send it, a copy of the edited photo is also saved to your phone\'s gallery. With this off, the edited copy is only sent. This setting is off by default.
Privacy
Remove the location
The app you send to gets no GPS position from the photo or the video.

Removes the GPS position from each photo and video before it is sent. The app you send to, and the person who gets it, cannot see where it was taken. Your own copy keeps its position. This setting is on by default.
Remove the camera details
Also remove the camera model, the serial numbers, the owner and the time taken.
Also removes the camera model, the serial numbers, the owner\'s name and the time taken from each photo before it is sent. Your own copy keeps them. This setting is on by default.
Random file names
Send copies under a random name, not the photo\'s own.
Each photo is sent under a random file name. A photo\'s own name often holds the date and time it was taken, and sometimes the name of the app that made it. This setting is on by default.
Remember what you sent
Fills the Sent album and marks photos you sent before. Incognito keeps nothing.
The gallery remembers which photos you sent. They fill the Sent album, and a photo you sent before carries a mark in the grid. The record stays on this phone. Nothing is recorded in incognito mode.
Clear the sent list
Empties the Sent album. Your photos stay where they are.
Clear the list of what you sent from the keyboard?
Immich

Browse your own Immich server in the gallery: its timeline and albums come after the phone\'s, and a picture from it is sent like one of yours. In Immich, make an API key under Account settings › API keys. Give it asset.read, asset.view, asset.download, album.read, timeline.read and user.read; add asset.upload to upload phone pictures from the send menu. The key stays on this phone and out of backups.
Server address
The address you open Immich at, such as https://photos.example.com
API key
Paste the key Immich showed when you made it
Check the connection
Asks the server who the key belongs to
Check
Connected as %1$s
The server turned the key down (%1$d). Check the key and its permissions.
Could not reach the server: %1$s
That does not look like a web address
Save data off Wi-Fi
Off Wi-Fi: thumbnails already on the phone only, small copies unless you pick Original, no uploads

On mobile data (any metered network), and always while data saving is on: the grid shows only Immich thumbnails the phone already has, and fetches no new ones. Opening a picture downloads the server\'s preview, about 1440 pixels across, and that preview is what is sent or edited, unless you pick Original in the quality chip. Videos and uploads to Immich wait for Wi-Fi. Thumbnails and previews you have seen are kept on the phone, up to 64 MB, so they show again without the network.
Delete from Immich in the viewer
Adds a Delete button to server pictures, with a warning each time

A deleted picture goes to Immich\'s trash, for every device and app that uses the server, and the server deletes it for good when its trash empties. If the server\'s trash is turned off, it is gone at once. The API key needs the asset.delete permission.
Let the keyboard delete from your Immich server?

Deleting in the gallery viewer removes the picture from the server itself, not just from this phone: every device and app that uses the server loses it. It sits in Immich\'s trash until the server empties it, usually after 30 days; with the trash turned off on the server it is deleted for good straight away. The viewer still asks before each delete.
